tag.name: GA4 - Google tag
tag.notes: Page views + page context for every event. Blocked when page_context.gtag is true (Site Kit placing GA4 directly), so GA4 never counts twice.

tag.name: GA4 event - campaign_view
tag.notes: Every campaign page (aw-analytics.js), with campaign_slug and campaign_title.

tag.name: GA4 event - view_item
tag.notes: Directory profile view; items from the dataLayer ecommerce object.

tag.name: GA4 event - view_item_list
tag.notes: A list of listings seen (Directory pages on load; related lists in view).

tag.name: GA4 event - select_item
tag.notes: A listing card clicked in any list.

tag.name: GA4 event - listing_action
tag.notes: Every action on a Directory profile (call, whatsapp, email, website, directions, social, donate, volunteer, claim, report, suggest_update, share, *_missing ...).

tag.name: GA4 event - generate_lead
tag.notes: A visitor contacts a listed organisation: lead_source call | whatsapp | email.

tag.name: GA4 event - campaign_action
tag.notes: Standard campaign event: action = letter_open, ground_toggle, objection_sent, objection_confirmed, rule_card_open, share, newsletter_optin, section_jump, document_open, guide_open, news_open, coverage_open, outbound, whatsapp_group, social_follow, volunteer_click, contact_click, call, email, faq_open, promo_click ...

tag.name: GA4 event - ad_slot_status
tag.notes: Per ad slot with code: filled / unfilled (AdSense data-ad-status), not_loaded, no_response, code.

tag.name: GA4 event - ad_slot_view
tag.notes: A filled ad slot at least half on screen for 1 second.

tag.name: GA4 event - volunteer_signup
tag.notes: form_submit_success where form = volunteer (GA4 cannot mark one parameter value as a key event).

tag.name: GA4 event - newsletter_signup
tag.notes: form_submit_success where form = newsletter (GA4 cannot mark one parameter value as a key event).

tag.name: GA4 event - claim_sent
tag.notes: form_submit_success where form = claim (GA4 cannot mark one parameter value as a key event).

tag.name: GA4 event - contact_sent
tag.notes: form_submit_success where form = contact (GA4 cannot mark one parameter value as a key event).

trigger.name: Block - Init when site sends to GA4 itself (gtag true)
